Shipwreck Cove GalleyPirates of the Caribbean: At World's EndFlip the map. Dinner is now.Every recipe serves 4.
    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersSingapore bathhouse dumplingsSteamed pork and prawn dumplings with soy, black vinegar and chilli oilHow to make it250g pork mince150g green prawns, chopped1 tbsp soy sauce, plus extra for dipping1 tsp salt24 dumpling wrappers3 tbsp black vinegar3 tbsp chilli oilMix the pork, prawns, soy and salt.Fill the wrappers and pleat closed.Steam in a lined bamboo basket.Mix the black vinegar, chilli oil and a little extra soy sauce for dipping.Jack's honey and smoked salt peanutsRoasted peanuts glazed with butter, honey and smoked salt, broken into clustersHow to make it300g peanuts30g butter3 tbsp honey1 tsp smoked saltMelt the butter with the honey and toss through the peanuts with the smoked salt.Spread on a lined tray and roast at 180°C for 10 minutes, stirring once.Cool until crunchy, then break into clusters.Locker crab and chive brioche toastsThe crabs carrying the Pearl across the sandHow to make itAs written, serves 4Sweet crab meat folded with lemon mayo and chives, piled on golden toasted brioche rounds with a dusting of paprika.Cut 16 rounds from 4 thick slices of brioche with a small cutter, brush with 30g melted butter and toast at 180°C for 8 minutes.Drain 250g cooked crab meat well and mix with 3 tbsp mayo, the zest and a squeeze of 1 lemon, 2 tbsp chopped chives, salt and pepper.Pile onto the cooled toasts, dust with sweet paprika and add a few chive tips.MainsSingapore chilli crabCrab pieces in a sweet chilli tomato sauce with egg ribbons, crusty bread to mop upHow to make it1.5kg blue swimmer crabs, cleaned and cut into pieces3 garlic cloves, crushed1 tbsp grated ginger2 red chillies, chopped2 tbsp oil150ml tomato sauce3 tbsp sweet chilli sauce1 tbsp soy sauce250ml water2 eggs, beaten1 baguetteFry the garlic, ginger and chilli in the oil. Add the tomato sauce, sweet chilli, soy and water.Add the crab, cover and cook until the shells turn red.Stir in the beaten eggs until just set. Serve with the baguette to mop up the sauce.Brethren Court Hainanese chicken riceNine pirate lords at one table in Shipwreck Cove, and nobody agreesHow to make it1.2kg chicken thighs, bone in40g ginger5 spring onions4 garlic cloves300g jasmine rice1 tbsp vegetable oil2 red chillies1 lime2 tbsp soy sauce1 Lebanese cucumber, sliced1 bunch corianderPoach the chicken in water with half the ginger, 2 spring onions and salt at a gentle simmer, then cool in ice water.Fry 2 crushed garlic cloves in the oil, add the rice and 600ml of the poaching stock and cook covered.Blitz the chillies with the rest of the garlic, a little ginger and lime juice. Pour hot oil over the rest of the ginger and spring onion, finely chopped.Slice the chicken and serve with the rice, cucumber, coriander, soy and both sauces.SweetsGreen flash pandan puddingPandan coconut pudding, mangoHow to make it800ml coconut milk100g caster sugar1 tsp pandan paste5 tbsp cornflour1/2 cup shredded coconut, toasted1 mango, dicedWhisk the coconut milk, sugar, pandan paste and cornflour over low heat until thick and glossy.Pour into glasses and chill for 3 hours.Top with toasted coconut and diced mango.DrinksSao Feng's Singapore slingGin, cherry liqueur, pineapple, lime and grenadine shaken, over ice with a splash of sodaHow to make it120ml gin60ml cherry liqueur360ml pineapple juice60ml lime juice40ml grenadine4 dashes of bitters100ml soda water4 pineapple wedges4 maraschino cherries1 bag iceShake the gin, cherry liqueur, pineapple juice, lime juice, grenadine and bitters hard with ice, in batches, until frothy.Strain into tall glasses filled with ice and top with a splash of soda water.Garnish with a pineapple wedge and a cherry.Arrack and lime punchRaised by nine Pirate Lords and their pieces of eight.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
